name: Warden's Glance
description: Cast a short glance across a sleeping hall and mark any dreamer whose dream has turned hostile.

name: Stately Hush
description: Raise a hush of dream force over a foe that dulls the foe's speech and reflexes.

name: Linen Screen
description: Hang a linen screen of dream force before a sleeper that stops a hostile dream at the threshold.

name: Warded Slumber
description: Hold a wounded ally in a guarded slumber that mends the body while no harm can reach the mind.

name: Doubled Reverie
description: Show a foe two overlapping dreams at once so the foe cannot tell which scene is real.

name: Dream Sentinel
description: Station a sentinel of dream force over a sleeper that rises to meet any mind that enters.

name: Vigil Net
description: Stretch a net of dream force across a doorway that drops any intruder into a sleep.

name: Upright Trance
description: Settle a foe into a court-still trance of upright sleep that holds while the dreamer keeps the dream.

name: Sovereign Dreamward
description: Close a whole sleeping hall inside a dream so strong that intruders sink to sleep at the door.

name: Dream Listening
description: Listen to the pooled dreams of a sleeping crowd and judge which of them has the strongest will.

name: Pooled Drowse
description: Pour a pool of drowse over a foe's feet so the foe wades through sleep as it rises.

name: Dreamwater Sip
description: Give a hurt ally a sip of dream water from the basin that quiets pain and restores a little strength.

name: Brim Guard
description: Raise the rim of the basin around the user so a hostile dream spills out and away.

name: Overspill Slumber
description: Tip the full basin so that sleep floods outward across a group of foes.

name: Resting Tide
description: Raise a slow tide of rest around a wounded company that closes cuts as it ebbs.

name: Dream Clearing
description: Empty the basin of fouled dream and refill it clean so a haunted ally sleeps free of it.

name: Sunken Dream
description: Sink a foe's mind to the bottom of the basin where no waking thought can follow.

name: Reservoir Refuge
description: Open a deep reservoir of dream force around the user to swallow a barrage of mind attacks.

name: Bottomless Slumber
description: Pour the whole basin onto a foe whose sleep then has no floor and no waking.

name: Updrift Sight
description: Rise on a warm updrift of dream force and look down upon the minds below.

name: Stooping Lull
description: Drop a lulling pressure on a foe from above like a hawk that settles on its prey.

name: Wingspan Veil
description: Spread a veil as wide as a wingspan that catches a blow before it lands.

name: Feathered Rest
description: Lay an ally on a bed of feathered dream force and let the body mend.

name: Sharp Waking
description: Snap an ally from the grip of a hostile dream into a sharp and sudden waking.

name: Hovering Trance
description: Hover over a foe's mind and let a steady trance sink from above until the foe stills.

name: Sky Reverie
description: Spread the foe's sight across a boundless sky dream so the foe loses all sense of ground.

name: Down Cleansing
description: Brush an ally's mind with a fine down of dream force that lifts a clinging curse.

name: Piercing Gaze
description: Fix a hawk's gaze on a foe's mind and fill it with a vision the foe cannot refuse.

name: Soaring Refuge
description: Lift the user and nearby allies into a sheltering dream above the reach of hostile minds.

name: Ascendant Reverie
description: Rise through the layers of the dream and step out of the waking world to appear elsewhere.

name: Silencing Hush
description: Impose the hush of a quiet court on a foe so the foe's voice and nerve fail.

name: Slumber Gauge
description: Gauge how deeply a person sleeps and how hard a hostile dream would pull at them.

name: Cushion Guard
description: Throw up a cushion of dream force that robs a blow of its bite.

name: Slow Lullaby
description: Hum the court's slow lullaby that lowers a company of foes toward sleep.

name: Rest Granted
description: Grant a worn ally a full deep rest in a single breathing that restores the body.

name: Gentle Dispelling
description: Dispel a binding dream from an ally's mind with a gentle sustained pressure.

name: Dream Lattice
description: Lay a lattice of sleeping force on the ground that closes around the first foe to cross it.

name: Regal Drowse
description: Cast a stately and heavy drowse that settles on a foe like a royal command to sleep.

name: Slumber Throne
description: Seat a foe's mind on a throne of sleep from which the foe cannot call on any technique.

name: Warden's Whisper
description: Listen on the wind for the whisper of any mind that approaches the sleeping camp.

name: Breeze Lull
description: Blow a lulling breeze across a foe that slows the foe's breath and step.

name: Lantern Rest
description: Keep a small lantern of dream light over an ally whose sleep then restores the ally's body.

name: Warding Veil
description: Stand a veil of dream force like a sentry before a sleeper and turn away any hostile mind.

name: Oathkeeper Slumber
description: Put a foe to sleep on the dreamer's word and hold the foe there until the oath is lifted.

name: Wakeful Mending
description: Heal an ally through a long vigil with a steady dream that never lets the ally's body slip.

name: Dread Scattering
description: Scatter a cloud of dread from an ally's mind as a strong wind scatters mist.

name: Lulling Snare
description: Set a sentry snare of dream force that sleeps the first hostile mind to touch the camp.

name: Wardsworn Hold
description: Hold a foe in an iron sleep on the strength of the ward the dreamer swore to keep.

name: Wind Dreamward
description: Hold a sentry dream across the whole camp that cancels every hostile mind-attack aimed into it.

name: Vigil Chant
description: Chant a low vigil verse that presses a foe toward sleep for as long as it is sung.

name: Sleeper's Voice
description: Hear the voice a sleeper speaks inside a dream and learn what the sleeper fears or wants.

name: Verse Rest
description: Sing a verse of rest over a hurt ally until sleep closes the ally's smaller wounds.

name: Cadence Veil
description: Repeat a protective refrain that thickens a veil of dream force around a sleeper.

name: Cantor's Prompt
description: Give an ally the first line of a waking verse so the ally rises from sleep alert.

name: Hymn Drowse
description: Sing a hymn in four parts that puts a group of foes to sleep one by one.

name: Dream Verse
description: Recite a dream verse that rewrites a foe's memory of the last few moments.

name: Chant Cleansing
description: Chant a cleansing line that lifts a haunting from the dreams of an ally.

name: Vigil Strength
description: Pass the strength of a sung vigil to an ally who must keep watch through the long hours.

name: Antiphonal Trance
description: Sing call and answer with a partner until every foe within hearing falls into a deep trance.

name: Chanted Snare
description: Leave a chanted snare on the ground that sings a trespassing foe to sleep.

name: Unending Vigil
description: Hold an unending vigil chant that keeps a whole field of foes in sleep for as long as the voices last.

name: Sky Lull
description: Send a lull down from the open sky onto a foe and slacken the foe's grip.

name: Cloud Divining
description: Read the shape of a cloud-like dream above a sleeper to learn what troubles the sleeper.

name: Unfurled Veil
description: Throw open a wide veil of dream force that lets a blow pass through without finding the user.

name: Stratus Drift
description: Drift through the dream as a cloud drifts and reappear a long step away.

name: Sky Rest
description: Lay an ally to rest under a dreamed open sky until the ally's wounds begin to close.

name: Wide Trance
description: Spread a trance as wide as the sky so that every foe beneath it sags.

name: Cloudless Slumber
description: Clear the sky of a foe's thought until only a blank bright slumber remains.

name: Apex Snare
description: Hang a snare of sleep high above a path so it falls on the foes who cross below.

name: Boundless Dreaming
description: Dissolve into an open-sky dream and step out again at any place the dreamer can picture.

name: Long Lull
description: Draw out a lull over many breaths until the foe's reactions fall far behind.

name: Bearing Sense
description: Take a bearing on the nearest sleeper by the pull of the sleeper's dream.

name: Steady Rest
description: Hold an ally in a steady dreamless rest that slowly closes the ally's wounds.

name: Course Veil
description: Hold a veil of dream force along the user's course that turns every blow aside from its line.

name: Keel Waking
description: Steady an ally's waking mind like a keel steadies a boat and keep the ally upright.

name: Heading Trance
description: Set a foe's mind on a slow heading toward sleep and keep it there with a light touch.

name: Distant Dream
description: Send a foe's mind far off into a dream so the foe fights an enemy who is not there.

name: Weary Cleansing
description: Wash the weariness of a long march and its dreams out of an ally's mind.

name: Far Slumber
description: Cast a slumber across a long distance onto a foe who has not yet seen the dreamer.

name: Compass Snare
description: Leave a snare that turns every foe's sense of direction to the wrong way and so sleeps them in circles.

name: Unhurried Dreaming
description: Draw a foe through a dream so long and calm that the foe forgets the fight and its purpose.
